text: 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅对外发布《关于推动科技创新和产业创新深度融合的意见》。意见提出，以关键核心技术突破提升产业链自主可控水平。推动集成电路、工业母机、高端仪器、先进材料、生物制造等重点领域关键核心技术攻关取得决定性突破。深入实施产业基础再造和重大技术装备攻关等工程，聚焦重点领域薄弱环节，强化基础零部件及基础元器件攻关，突破关键基础软件，攻克关键基础材料，加强先进基础工艺和产业技术基础研发。
text_en: The General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council released the Opinions on Promoting the Deep Integration of Technological Innovation and Industrial Innovation. The Opinions propose improving the independent and controllable level of industrial chains through breakthroughs in key core technologies. Decisive breakthroughs should be achieved in key core technologies in key areas such as integrated circuits, industrial machine tools, high-end instruments, advanced materials, and biomanufacturing. Projects such as the industrial base reengineering and major technical equipment breakthroughs should be implemented in depth, focusing on weak links in key areas, strengthening breakthroughs in basic parts and components, achieving breakthroughs in key basic software, conquering key basic materials, and strengthening R&D in advanced basic processes and industrial technical foundations.
